messages.author: 9783d9fe56013431
messages.subject: subsets
parts:
Hi,
Simple question, so sorry upfront.
How do I define a subset of data?
If I have a particular variable, say "chrom" and 10 different
categories within that variable, how do I plot one of these at a
time?
Facets has been great for plotting them all at the same time using

qplot(position,X, facets= .~chrom, colour=class, size=1)

But now I'd like to plot one chrom at a time. I gather I should use
subset to do this rather than facets? But not really clear on how to
use subset within this format. The following did not plot just the
subset I wanted, but rather all the data.

qplot(position, X, data=subset(alldata, chrom="2L"), colour=class,
size=1).

Many thanks.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: subsets
parts:
Hi Squid,

You'd want subset(alldata, chrom == "2L")

- notice the double equals!

You might also want to have a look at http://had.co.nz/plyr. There's
an example there showing how to create a plot for each subset of a
bigger dataset.

Hadley
